lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 25-30 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-linear grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits and pectoral fin. Clusters exhibit roughly uniform spacing along the horizontal mid-line of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, most notably in the central flank region where the vertical lines pass through the centroids of the circular clusters.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance increase on the dorsal-facing edge and a corresponding shadow gradient on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with approximately 5-8 distinct points of local maxima visible.
